title: presenting things! the new living world collection // free pixel asset pack //
author: zimraz
selftext:
# // living world things // greens // animated pixel vegetation // shrubs, grasses, trees, reeds and palms... //

hi r/aigamedev ! i got a lil tired of only making pixel VFX for the living world collection so...

# i have just released a new free pack, this time with >things< inside, 12 different trees and plants with 36 states of wind

get it here: \[https://zimraz.itch.io/living-world-things-greens-free-pack\](https://zimraz.itch.io/living-world-things-greens-free-pack)

check out the rest of my stuff here:

\[https://zimraz.itch.io/\](https://zimraz.itch.io/) (**more free goodies in there, and more stuff coming regularly**)

would love to hear your thoughts, in the form of a comment or a rating

this and the whole living world project was made using codex (mostly astra) with aseprite skills as core for automation and production, it's taken most of the boring tasks completely off the to-do list
